title: Agent Skills SKILL.md Frontmatter
description: Portable frontmatter contract for SKILL.md. Core fields follow the open Agent Skills specification (https://agentskills.io/specification). Runtime extension fields are namespaced under x-runtime and are stripped or ignored by conforming validators.

name.description: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and single hyphens only. Must equal the parent skill directory name. Reserved words 'anthropic' and 'claude' are rejected by Anthropic's hosted validation.

description.description: Third person. States what the skill does AND when to use it. Angle brackets are excluded for Anthropic hosted-platform compatibility.

license.description: Short license identifier or reference to a bundled license file.

compatibility.description: Concrete environment, runtime, package, command, or network requirements. Omit when there are none.

metadata.description: Client- or organization-specific metadata. All values must be strings.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill, as a quoted string.

allowed-tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL and not portable. Space-separated pre-approved tool patterns. Honored by Claude Code CLI and Copilot; ignored by the Claude Agent SDK. Prefer omitting it.

x-runtime.description: Non-standard, runtime-specific hints. Conforming runtimes ignore this key; the install tooling projects it into runtime-native frontmatter fields.
